shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---' && rg --files app && printf '\\n--- page ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx"
/bin/bash -c "find .. -name AGENTS.md -print && git status --short && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -c "cat components/request-metadata.tsx && printf '\\n--- Cache Components docs (local) ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && printf '\\n--- connection docs ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md && printf '\\n--- suspense usage references ---\\n' && rg -n \"<Suspense|connection\\(\\)\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -g '*.md' | head -60"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Update File: next.config.ts @@ -const nextConfig: NextConfig = {} +const nextConfig: NextConfig = { + cacheComponents: true, +} *** Update File: app/layout.tsx @@ import type { ReactNode } from 'react' +import { Suspense } from 'react' import { RequestMetadata } from '@/components/request-metadata' @@ -
Operations
- +
+ Operations +
+ Loading request details…}> + + {children} *** Update File: components/request-metadata.tsx @@ import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto' +import { connection } from 'next/server' -export function RequestMetadata() { +export async function RequestMetadata() { + await connection() + const generatedAt = new Date().toISOString() *** End Patch PATCH npm run build"
/bin/bash -c "git status --short && git diff -- app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -c "for request in 1 2; do curl -fsS http://localhost:3000 | tr '<' '\\n' | rg -o 'Request ["'^<]+'"' | head -1; done"
/bin/bash -c "git status --short && git check-ignore -v .next next-env.d.ts || true && cat next-env.d.ts && printf '\\n--- ignores ---\\n' && ls -la | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: .gitignore
@@
 node_modules/
+.next/
 __agent_eval__/
*** End Patch
PATCH

git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- .gitignore app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\n--- changed-file line references ---\\n' && rg -n \"cacheComponents|Suspense|Main navigation|RequestMetadata|connection\\(|generatedAt|sample|requestId|\\.next\" next.config.ts app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx .gitignore && printf '\\n--- generated type file ---\\n' && rg -n \"reference types|\\.next/types\" next-env.d.ts"
